🌟 Seraphic Skincare Affiliate Guide

Welcome to the Seraphic Skincare Affiliate Program!

We love collaborating with passionate skincare enthusiasts and being able to see our affiliates come up with creative ways to share our products. With tens of thousands of customer reviews, dramatic results, and eye-catching transformations, our tools are traditionally inspired with modern designs to not only elevate self-care but also create the kind of content that gets people talking.

About the Brand

At Seraphic Skincare (pronounced seh-RA-fik), we believe exfoliation should be natural, reusable, effective, and affordable to help people everywhere achieve smooth, radiant, can’t-stop-touching-it skin—all from the comfort of home. Think self-care that actually works—and looks beautiful in your bathroom. Plus, we’re certified vegan and women-owned!

Affiliate Benefits

15% Commission – Earn on every referral sale through your affiliate link or unique audience coupon code.

20% Commission on Bundles – Maximize your earnings by promoting our most popular bundles. Customers love the value, you’ll love the bigger payouts.

Extra Bonuses – Stay even more motivated by earning monthly, quarterly, or annual bonuses by hitting sales goals.

FREE Products – Once approved, you’ll be able to select free products to help you start strong.

FAST & FREE Shipping – No minimum and no exceptions. All orders are shipped fast and free.

Get Paid Regularly & Easily – Get paid via PayPal on the 1st of every month (or next business day if the 1st falls on a weekend or holiday).

Products That Sell Themselves – Backed by rave reviews and a loyal following, Seraphic is a trusted brand with undeniable proof of results.

Tips & Resources – All products have instruction videos available and creator “cheat sheets” for tips on maximizing content creation so you can feel confident with what you share.

Why Promote Seraphic Skincare?

 ✔️ Affordable, reusable products with premium results.
 ✔️ A growing line for both men and women, broadening your audience potential.
 ✔️ Backed by tens of thousands of glowing reviews and real customer love.
 ✔️ Built-in content opportunities that drive engagement and conversions.

Content Creation Ideas

Our products practically make content for you—they’re engaging, satisfying, and built for share-worthy moments:

🎥 Texture Close-Up – Show the mitt’s unique scrunch texture when wet—visually striking and curiosity-driven.
 ✨ Before & After Transformations – Capture that radiant glow for dramatic, scroll-stopping results.
 🔥 The Dead Skin Reveal – The ultimate viral moment. Nothing gets attention like seeing dead skin on the mitt or on the shower floor.
 🛁 Luxury in Action – Highlight how simple, premium, reusable, and results-driven our tools are to incorporate into any routine.

Additional Information

Who Can Join?
We encourage anyone to apply that is passionate about skincare, self-care, and beauty—from influencers and bloggers to beauty professionals and enthusiasts. We celebrate diversity and creativity within our affiliate community. To qualify, you must be 18 or older, a U.S. resident, and maintain an active public social media account. For more information, please see our Terms of Service.

How Do I Join?
Joining is easy! Simply complete our affiliate application form. Once approved, you’ll receive your unique referral link and full access to the affiliate dashboard. By participating, you agree that Seraphic Skincare may share your photos, captions, and content across our marketing channels. Affiliates must follow our program guidelines—no spamming, false claims, or unauthorized advertising. Please review our full Terms & Conditions before applying.

What Is The Process After I’m Approved?
Once approved, you will receive an email welcoming you to our Affiliate program. This email will include your unique affiliate link to share with your audiences and access to our affiliate dashboard. You'll earn commission for every purchase made via your link.  When someone clicks your link and makes a purchase, the system tracks it automatically, ensuring you get credit for the sale.

How Do I Share?

Share Seraphic Skincare your way—on your blog, social media, YouTube, or other creative platforms. We make it easy with ready-to-use images and content. Highlight our premium exfoliation tools that deliver spa-like results at home, are reusable, eco-friendly, and affordable. Show off dramatic before & after results—and see how fun it is to make money while inspiring others to elevate their self-care routine.

👉 Ready to start? It’s simple—share your affiliate link, inspire your audience, and get paid! Let’s grow together!

Seraphic Skincare Affiliate Program

Terms & Conditions

Welcome to the Seraphic Skincare Affiliate Program (the “Program”). By applying to and participating in the Program, you agree to the following Terms & Conditions (the “Agreement”). Please read carefully before enrolling.



1. Eligibility

  • You must be at least 18 years of age.

  • You must be a legal resident of one of the fifty (50) United States, with a valid email address and a payment account (e.g., PayPal) to receive commissions.

  • Applications will be evaluated based on eligibility criteria and alignment with Seraphic Skincare’s brand aesthetic. Admission is at Seraphic Skincare’s sole discretion.

  • Corporate entities are not eligible. Employees, officers, directors, agents, and representatives of Seraphic Skincare, its affiliates, or related companies are not permitted to participate.

  • This Program is void in all U.S. territories (including Puerto Rico), possessions, overseas military installations, and where prohibited by law.



2. Enrollment & Participation

  • Once approved, you will receive a unique affiliate link and (if assigned) a coupon code.

  • You may promote Seraphic Skincare products through approved channels, including websites, blogs, email, and social media.

  • You agree to represent the brand in a professional, accurate, and positive manner.



3. Affiliate Links & Coupons

  • Affiliate links are automatically generated. If a customer clicks on multiple affiliate links, the most recent click receives credit.

  • Only assigned coupon codes may be promoted. Affiliates without a coupon code may not promote coupon use.

  • No double commissions will be awarded if both a link and a coupon code are used on the same purchase.

  • Use of coupon sites, spam, or paid advertising on Seraphic Skincare trademarks is strictly prohibited.



4. Commissions & Payments

  • Commissions are earned on qualifying purchases made via your affiliate link or coupon code, excluding taxes, shipping, and fees.

  • Payments are disbursed via PayPal on the first day of every month, or the next business day if the first day falls on a weekend or holiday. 

  • Transactions that are canceled, refunded, or result in chargebacks are ineligible for commission.

  • You may not earn commissions on your own purchases.

  • Seraphic Skincare reserves the right to withhold or revoke commissions for fraudulent or noncompliant activity.

  • Bonus incentives may be offered at Seraphic Skincare’s discretion.



5. Marketing Tools

Seraphic Skincare may provide promotional assets (e.g., banners, logos, product images) for affiliate use. These materials may not be altered and must only be used as intended.



6. Affiliate Responsibilities

Affiliates must:

  • Comply with all applicable laws, including FTC disclosure requirements. (i.e., clearly stating that you may earn commissions from links).

  • Represent Seraphic Skincare products truthfully and in a positive light.

  • Align their content with Seraphic Skincare’s brand aesthetic.

  • Avoid false, misleading, or prohibited claims.

  • Not share confidential information.

  • Avoid coupon websites, spam, and unauthorized advertising.

  • Note that because prices and availability of Product may vary from time to time, Participants are prohibited from including any price information in their Materials.  Any and all Product used by Participant in connection with Materials (defined below) is at Participant’s sole cost and expense and will not be reimbursed by Seraphic Skincare.. Likewise, transportation to and from any location in connection with Materials creation is at Participant’s sole cost and expense. However, from time to time, Seraphic Skincare may gift Product to Participant as determined in its sole discretion.

  • Tag and mention @seraphicskincare (for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube) and @seraphic.skincare (for TikTok) in social posts (visible “above the fold” or superimposed in stories). Follow Seraphic Skincare social media accounts. 

  • Not promote competing brands.

  • Ensure content is original, honest, non-infringing (be participants own original work), and not AI-generated. 

  • Avoid offensive, defamatory, discriminatory, or inappropriate content. Not contain or reference content that is disparaging, defamatory, libelous, threatening, abusive, deceptive, fraudulent, invasive of another’s privacy, tortious, or otherwise illegal, offensive or inappropriate in any way.

  • Not disclose personal or private information about Seraphic Skincare or others.

Violation of these responsibilities may result in forfeiture of commissions and immediate termination from the Program.



7. Content Use

By participating, you grant Seraphic Skincare a non-exclusive, royalty-free, perpetual, worldwide license to use, modify, repost, and share affiliate content featuring our products, with appropriate credit.



8. Confidentiality

Affiliates may be exposed to confidential information, including upcoming product launches, sales, and business strategies. Such information must not be disclosed, used for personal gain, or shared with third parties.



9. Cookies & Tracking

  • The Program uses cookies to track customer referrals.

  • If a user disables or clears cookies, commissions cannot be tracked or awarded.

  • Cookie duration will be disclosed at registration. Any order within the tracking period will result in commission credit to the referring affiliate.



10. Termination

Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time, with or without cause, by written notice.  Seraphic Skincare reserves the right to terminate accounts for violations, fraudulent activity, or conduct inconsistent with brand values.



11. Limitation of Liability

Seraphic Skincare is not liable for indirect, incidental, or special damages related to the Program.  Our total liability will not exceed the total commissions paid to you under this Agreement.



12. Modifications

Seraphic Skincare may update these Terms & Conditions at any time. Material changes will be communicated via email or dashboard notification. Continued participation constitutes acceptance of updated terms.



13. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California, without regard to conflict of law principles.



Acceptance

By joining the Seraphic Skincare Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms & Conditions.

For questions, please contact info@seraphic-skincare.com.



✨ Thank you for partnering with Seraphic Skincare. We’re excited to grow with you!
